analysis.descriptor: Three upright cylindrical tins in graduated sizes, tall, medium and small, standing in a row with thin gold rims at top and bottom. The smallest has a clear translucent white snap lid. Each body is maroon with a large orange arch-shaped label outlined in cream and gold, covering most of the front. Inside the arch sits a round portrait of a blue-skinned deity with a feathered crown, framed by a small ribbon banner at each side and a registered mark. Above it is a curved line of text, SINCE 1925. Below is a red plaque with white bold text KRISHNA, then COMPOUNDED in yellow and ASAFOETIDA in bold yellow. A small green vegetarian symbol sits at the right edge.
